== Summary ==
Source-only comparison for [[Relatively Unprotected (Errata)]] and [[Relatively Unprotected (Errata 3)]]. Left: archived official complete composed region, [[:File:V9-L-relativelyunprotected-Set9-archive-2021-10-05-composed.png]]. Right: official October 2023 partial, [[:File:V9-L-relativelyunprotected-Set9-October-2023-partial.png]], using its original mask. The comparison presentation displays each complete region at 745 pixels wide; exact unscaled sources are preserved separately. Header/lore typography, frame and badge layout differ between the published cutouts; Relatively Unprotected also reflows the OR between its functions. No card pixels were repainted or completed. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
